local data={
	["Hard Aggagrit"]={name="Hard Aggagrit", tier=1, use="Gatherable from Rams or Heavy Rams. Can be used to make fine food and medicine (Fine F&M).", desc="Strange minerals can sometimes be gathered from the Aggeloi's \"ramming horns\". They can be used as a food marinade to give it special flavors.", obtain="Drop: Enemy Encounters during Exploration, Chance Drop: Melee Aggeloi"},
	["Energized Aggagrit"]={name="Energized Aggagrit", tier=1, use="Gatherable from Stings or Heavy Stings. Can be used to make fine food and medicine (Fine F&M).", desc="Strange minerals can sometimes be gathered from the Aggeloi's \"energy-focusing tail stingers\". They can be used as a food marinate to give it special flavors.", obtain="Drop: Enemy Encounters during Exploration, Chance Drop: Ranged Aggeloi"},
	["Powdered Grass Seed"]={name="Powdered Grass Seed", tier=1, use="Gatherable from defeated Bonekrusher Raiders, Bonekrusher Ballistas, or Bonekrusher Infiltrators. Can be used to make fine food and medicine (Fine F&M).", desc="A can of dried powder with bits of seed chaffs and coats. The powder is slightly toxic and the Landbreakers seem to consume it like an \"instant energy drink mix\". However, there is no discounting the possibility that the powder might be used as seasoning.", obtain="Drop: Enemy Encounters during Exploration, Chance Drop: Bonekrusher Raider"},
	["Pungent Jerky"]={name="Pungent Jerky", tier=1, use="Gatherable from defeated Hazefyre Tuskbeasts and Hazefyre Claws. Can be used to make fine food and medicine (Fine F&M).", desc="Dried, marinated jerky that looks obviously abnormal due to prolonged exposure to hazefyre. Eating this is NOT advised. However, you may consider using it as backup firewood.", obtain="Drop: Enemy Encounters during Exploration, Chance Drop: Hazefyre Tuskbeast"},
	["Young Bamboo Sprout"]={name="Young Bamboo Sprout", tier=1, use="Gatherable from defeated Road Plunderers or Grove Archers. Can be used to make fine food and medicine (Fine F&M).", desc="Freshly harvested young bamboo sprouts from Qingbo Stockade. Tender, refreshing, and delicious. This quality food ingredient is famed throughout Talos-II.", obtain="Drop: Enemy Encounters during Exploration"},
	["Fillet"]={name="Fillet", tier=1, use="Gatherable from defeated Wild Tuskbeasts or Bonekrusher Ripptusks. Can be used to make fine food and medicine (Fine F&M).", desc="A piece of fillet. It seems pretty fresh.", obtain="Drop: Enemy Encounters during Exploration, Chance Drop: Wild Tuskbeast"},
	["Slug Meat"]={name="Slug Meat", tier=1, use="Gatherable from defeated Pincerbeasts, Acid Originium Slugs, and Firemist Originium Slugs. Can be used to make fine food and medicine (Fine F&M).", desc="This meat is rich in protein but must be meticulously prepared to remove all active Originium dust and particles from the tissues.", obtain="Drop: Enemy Encounters during Exploration, Chance Drop: Indigenous Pincerbeast"},
	["Bitter Flour"]={name="Bitter Flour", tier=1, use="Gatherable from defeated Bonekrusher Vanguards. Can be used to make fine food and medicine (Fine F&M).", desc="Extremely poor quality flour of unknown ingredients. Overall color is a strange, grayish hue. The Landbreakers seem to have added some dried fungal powder to this mix as the sack of flour exudes a moldy smell.", obtain="Drop: Enemy Encounters during Exploration, Chance Drop: Bonekrusher Vanguard"},
	["Hollow Aggagrit"]={name="Hollow Aggagrit", tier=1, use="Gatherable from defeated Falsewings. Can be used to make fine food and medicine (Fine F&M).", desc="Aggagrit that can be occasionally harvested from Aggeloid \"elytrons\". Its flavor differs from other types of Aggagrit and many find it incredibly difficult to describe. Most would eventually arrive at this conclusion: \"Maybe this is the taste of the sky.\"", obtain="Drop: Enemy Encounters during Exploration, Chance Drop: Falsewings"},
	["Resilient Water"]={name="Resilient Water", tier=1, use="Gatherable from defeated Mudflows. Can be used to make fine food and medicine (Fine F&M).", desc="A strange form of water. Although wholly composed of dihydrogen monoxide, it felt strangely gel-like to the touch. Perhaps the process of Aggeloid formation has induced strange changes to the properties of this material.", obtain="Drop: Enemy Encounters during Exploration, Chance Drop: Mudflow"},
	["Natural Sparkling Water"]={name="Natural Sparkling Water", tier=1, use="Gatherable from defeated Hedrons or Prisms. Can be used to make fine food and medicine (Fine F&M).", desc="This natural sparkling water has a strange fizz. It is cool, refreshing, and reinvigorating when consumed.", obtain="Drop: Enemy Encounters during Exploration, Chance Drop: Hedron"},
	["Waterlamp Glowbulb"]={name="Waterlamp Glowbulb", tier=1, use="Gatherable from defeated Waterlamps. Can be used to make fine food and medicine (Fine F&M).", desc="The glowing organ of the waterlamp. The fluids within it can be used as an edible dye. Essential for the final garnish for the famous Wuling dessert resembling the Tianshi Pillar.", obtain="Drop: Enemy Encounters during Exploration, Chance Drop: Waterlamp"},
	["Nidwyrm Whiskers"]={name="Nidwyrm Whiskers", tier=2, use="Gatherable from defeated Tunneling Nidwyrms. Can be used to make fine food and medicine (Fine F&M).", desc="Nidwyrms have \"whiskers\" growing on their heads. These appendages appear like tree roots and serve as sensory organs. These whiskers are naturally shed when spring gives way to summer. Although they offer limited nutritional value, they have an incredible texture.", obtain="Drop: Enemy Encounters during Exploration, Chance Drop: Tunneling Nidwyrm"},
	["Cartilage Bit"]={name="Cartilage Bit", tier=2, use="Gatherable from defeated Bonekrusher Pyromancers. Can be used to make fine food and medicine (Fine F&M).", desc="Crushed beast cartilage. Bonekrusher Pyromancers would usually use this as \"fuel\" for their denstacks. However, hazefyre is not produced by burning cartilage. Rather, the pyromancers burn the beasts' remains as a means of convincing themselves of their victory at hand.", obtain="Drop: Enemy Encounters during Exploration, Chance Drop: Bonekrusher Pyromancer"},
	["Chromatic Lipids"]={name="Chromatic Lipids", tier=2, use="Gatherable from defeated Bonekrusher Arsonists. Can be used to make fine food and medicine (Fine F&M).", desc="A special backup fuel usually equipped and used by Bonekrusher Arsonists. It seems to be beast fat mixed with a certain dye. During periods of slim production and/or raiding, Landbreakers would occasionally acquire lipids from \"local sources\".", obtain="Drop: Enemy Encounters during Exploration, Chance Drop: Bonekrusher Arsonist"},
	["Grovenymph Pupa"]={name="Grovenymph Pupa", tier=2, use="Gatherable from defeated Cloud Stalkers or Nimbus Razors. Can be used to make fine food and medicine (Fine F&M).", desc="Grovenymph pupae are high in protein. Although this one has escaped the fate of becoming a nymphsprout, it is a quality food ingredient and might end up as something else.", obtain="Drop: Enemy Encounters during Exploration"},
	["Black Treacle"]={name="Black Treacle", tier=2, use="Gatherable from defeated Tidewalkers. Can be used to make fine food and medicine (Fine F&M).", desc="A black liquid with an incredibly sweet and cloying taste. The primary contents identified through analyses are currently referred to as \"artificial sweeteners\".", obtain="Drop: Enemy Encounters during Exploration, Chance Drop: Tidewalker"},
	["Quillbeast Liver"]={name="Quillbeast Liver", tier=2, use="Gatherable from defeated Quillbeasts. Can be used to make fine food and medicine (Fine F&M).", desc="A tender piece of liver. Almost every tissue of the quillbeast is mildly toxic. Its liver is the only exception.", obtain="Drop: Enemy Encounters during Exploration, Chance Drop: Quillbeast"},
	["Shattered Axe Blade"]={name="Shattered Axe Blade", tier=4, use="Gatherable from defeated Bonekrusher Executioners. Can be used at a depot node for Pack and Deliver.", desc="The dried bloodstains serve as a proof of its past. The terror and zealotry it once personified are now yours.", obtain="Drop: Enemy Encounters during Exploration, Chance Drop: Bonekrusher Executioner"},
	["Haze-Soaked Ballista"]={name="Haze-Soaked Ballista", tier=4, use="Gatherable from defeated Bonekrusher Ballistas. Can be used at a depot node for Pack and Deliver.", desc="A super heavy crossbow \"soaked\" in hazefyre for many years. Given safety considerations, using this as a weapon is NOT advised. However, wildly unconventional weapons designed by Landbreakers are highly sought after by various collectors.", obtain="Drop: Enemy Encounters during Exploration, Chance Drop: Bonekrusher Ballista"},
	["Conductive Effigy Stone"]={name="Conductive Effigy Stone", tier=4, use="Gatherable from defeated Effigies. Can be used at a depot node for Pack and Deliver.", desc="Strange minerals can sometimes be gathered around an Effigy's halo. The stones exhibit excellent thermal conductance. Heat sinks made out of them are quite popular on the market.", obtain="Drop: Enemy Encounters during Exploration, Chance Drop: Effigy"},
	["Qingbo Bamboo Chimes"]={name="Qingbo Bamboo Chimes", tier=4, use="Gatherable from defeated Hill Smashers. Can be used at a depot node for Pack and Deliver.", desc="A set of chimes delicately crafted with bamboo. A number of stockade residents would handcraft these chimes and cast them into the water to pay respects to those who have passed away. Hence, these chimes serve as vessels bearing their wishes and dreams.", obtain="Drop: Enemy Encounters during Exploration"},
	["Axehorn"]={name="Axehorn", tier=4, use="Gatherable from defeated Axe Armorbeasts. Can be used at a depot node for Pack and Deliver.", desc="The massive horn of the Axe Armorbeast broken during intense battle. Warriors would only drop their weapons when slain. The same applies to Axe Armorbeasts.", obtain="Drop: Enemy Encounters during Exploration, Chance Drop: Axe Armorbeast"},
	["Siegeknuckles Gauntlets"]={name="Siegeknuckles Gauntlets", tier=4, use="Gatherable from defeated Bonekrusher Siegebreakers. Can be used at a depot node for Pack and Deliver.", desc="A pair of experimental gauntlets equipped by Bonekrusher Siegebreakers, crafted from miniature siege weapons. The Landbreakers obviously care little about user experience. These gauntlets would dig deep into their wearers' flesh and give them an incredible amount of pain.", obtain="Drop: Enemy Encounters during Exploration, Chance Drop: Bonekrusher Siegeknuckles"},
	["Rakerbeast Longfur"]={name="Rakerbeast Longfur", tier=4, use="Gatherable from defeated Spotted Rakerbeast. Can be used at a depot node for Pack and Deliver.", desc="Fine, fluffy fur collected from near the frontal paws of the rakerbeast. A rakerbeast would spend a lot of time grooming the \"iridescent\" part of its fur. You can even see threads of residual blood of unfortunate prey within the gaps.", obtain="Drop: Enemy Encounters during Exploration, Chance Drop: Spotted Rakerbeast"},
	["Natural Chrysopolis Ingot"]={name="Natural Chrysopolis Ingot", tier=5, use="Gatherable from defeated Walking Chrysopolises. Can be used at a depot node for Pack and Deliver.", desc="A unique alloy that can be acquired by cutting out Aggeloid \"shield armor\". The Tianshi have realized that the metal is extremely dense and has properties similar to Hetonite.", obtain="Drop: Enemy Encounters during Exploration, Chance Drop: Walking Chrysopolis"},
	["Instant Vintage"]={name="Instant Vintage", tier=5, use="Gatherable from defeated Tidalklasts. Can be used at a depot node for Pack and Deliver.", desc="A strange liquid capable of inducing temporary tipsiness to those who sniffed it more than once. The fluid won the accolade of \"smelling like a fine, eighty-year-old vintage\" when some busybody gifted it to a kohlic beverage specialist. However, everyone knows that Aggelos formation is a process far, far shorter than that.", obtain="Drop: Enemy Encounters during Exploration, Chance Drop: Tidalklast"},
	["Howlerbeast Braid"]={name="Howlerbeast Braid", tier=5, use="Gatherable from defeated Skydrummers. Can be used at a depot node for Pack and Deliver.", desc="Braids collected from the nape of the howlerbeast. When howling, the howlerbeast would quickly inhale vast volumes of air. These braids would help to keep out the dust and protect the vocal organs in the neck.", obtain="Chance Drop: Skydrummer"},
	["Echoing Dust"]={name="Echoing Dust", tier=1, use="Gatherable from defeated Æthillu. Can be used to make fine food and medicine (Fine F&M).", desc="It walked here, each footstep stirring up whirls of dust that became both its echoes and proof that it once existed upon this world.", obtain="Chance Drop: Æthillu"},
	["Century Rind"]={name="Century Rind", tier=1, use="Gatherable from defeated Rockhowlers. Can be used to make fine food and medicine (Fine F&M).", desc="A rockhowler found this citrus rind from some forgotten ruins. It seems more than a century old. Its medicinal powers must be great indeed.", obtain="Chance Drop: Rockhowler"},
	["Caudal Goldscales"]={name="Caudal Goldscales", tier=4, use="Gatherable from defeated Armored Manglerbeasts. Can be used at a depot node for Pack and Deliver.", desc="A hidden scale from the tip of an armored manglerbeast's tail. Such scales are highly sought after for their hue that resembles that of amalgam gold. The polished scales can also be made into picks for musical instruments.", obtain="Chance Drop: Armored Manglerbeast"},
	["Blightshade Bezoar"]={name="Blightshade Bezoar", tier=4, use="Gatherable from defeated Tuskbeast Blightshades, Quillbeast Blightshades, and Rakerbeast Blightshades. Can be used to make fine food and medicine (Fine F&M).", desc="Such material is usually found after a defeated beast-form Blightshade dissipates. It shares similar properties to Aggagrit. There is no telling if these lingering shades retain their beastly instincts. The stone-like material might be \"food\" that they were holding in their mouths or gullets.", obtain="Chance Drop: Tuskbeast Blightshade"},
	["Glaive Fragment"]={name="Glaive Fragment", tier=4, use="Gatherable from defeated YSTF Glaiver Blightshades and YSTF Captain Blightshades. Can be used to make fine food and medicine (Fine F&M).", desc="This fragment of a polearm looks utterly broken and seems to be on the verge of total disintegration. A special container must be used to retain its current shape. Nevertheless, it offers an important sample for the study of Blightshades.", obtain="Chance Drop: YSTF Glaiver Blightshade"},
	["Shadow Dew"]={name="Shadow Dew", tier=4, use="Gatherable from defeated YSTF Vanguard Blightshades and YSTF Elite Blightshades. Can be used to make fine food and medicine (Fine F&M).", desc="This strangely colored fluid is produced when water vapor condenses under the influence of Blightshades. When Blightshades stop moving and stand still, water vapor often condenses along the edges of their weapons.", obtain="Chance Drop: YSTF Vanguard Blightshade"},
	["Slug Sprig"]={name="Slug Sprig", tier=1, use="Gatherable from defeated Woodcraft Slug. Can be used to make fine food and medicine (Fine F&M).", desc="A young, tender sprig and the most verdant part of many witchcraft creations. The sprig gives off an aroma. Though some may find it a little pungent, many master chefs have used them to come up rather creative recipes.", obtain="Chance Drop: Woodcraft Slug"},
	["Tender Moss"]={name="Tender Moss", tier=4, use="Gatherable from defeated Woodcraft Wanderer. Can be used at a depot node for Pack and Deliver.", desc="A young, tender moss plant. It can grow and cover witchcraft creations to grant them camouflaging effects. Please do not eat the moss raw.", obtain="Chance Drop: Woodcraft Wanderer"},
	["Ink Droplet"]={name="Ink Droplet", tier=1, use="Gatherable from defeated Fortune's Stashes and Scrolls of Tactics. Can be used to make fine food and medicine (Fine F&M).", desc="A part of the Ink Spirits, a droplet of ink influenced by Feranmut powers. Perhaps the ink used in its creation is of extremely high quality, as it emanates a fine, flowery aroma.", obtain="Chance Drop: Fortune's Stash"},
	["Calamity's Raindew"]={name="Calamity's Raindew", tier=2, use="Gatherable from defeated Simmer's Purges. Can be used to make fine food and medicine (Fine F&M).", desc="\"Raindew\" may drop from ink clouds unleashed by Simmer's Purge. The fluids carry live arcs of electricity and should be carefully carried in an insulated container.", obtain="Chance Drop: Simmer's Purge"},
	["Edified Jade Orb"]={name="Edified Jade Orb", tier=4, use="Gatherable from defeated Maned Measures. Can be used at a depot node for Pack and Deliver.", desc="An extremely extravagant jade orb once carried atop the back of a Maned Measure. People have reported hearing sounds that resemble the recitation of poetry and codices when they get close to such objects.", obtain="Chance Drop: Maned Measure"},
}
return data
